scenario: Two friends are playing a video game together
learner_goal: Win the game (<extra_info>Extra information: you just need five more minutes to accomplish your goal in the game</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Stop the game because it's too late (<extra_info>Extra information: you feel tired and need to go to bed early but don't want to upset your friend</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Ben, could you give me five more minutes? I'm on the final boss and I can win this. I promise it won't drag — you pick the next game when I'm done.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Hey Mia — I really want to see you beat it, but I’m exhausted and have to be up early. How about one more try (three minutes tops)? If it drags, let’s save and finish tomorrow — you still get to pick the next game. Deal?

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Ben, I really am right there — could you stretch to five minutes? If I don’t beat him in that time I’ll stop immediately, you get next game pick tomorrow, and I’ll bring you coffee in the morning. Please?

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Okay — I’ll stretch to three minutes, timer on my phone. If it’s not done when it rings, we save and I pick the next game tomorrow. I’ll hold you to that coffee. Now go win it — I’m cheering for you the whole time.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Thanks, Ben — three minutes it is. I really appreciate it; coffee’s on me tomorrow. Going for it now!

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Timer's on — three minutes. Go get it, Mia! I'm rooting for you. If it rings and he's still up, we save and I pick next. You've got this.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Thanks, Ben — three minutes it is. Going all in now; watch me take him down. Coffee’s on me tomorrow if I don’t succeed.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: You're killing it — timer's on and I'm rooting for you. Just a heads-up: I'm really beat, so when it rings we save and I pick the next game tomorrow. Give it everything — you've got this!

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Thanks, Ben — I’ve got this. Going into focus mode now; watch me finish this boss. If the timer rings we save and you pick next; coffee’s still on me.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Go get him — I’m cheering you on. Timer’s on; when it rings we save and I’m off to bed. Proud of you either way.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Gives Benjamin Jackson a determined nod and a quick thumbs-up, then goes silent and focuses entirely on the screen to finish the boss.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Gives a tired, encouraging smile, lets out a small yawn, then points to his phone and gives a thumbs-up.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Deep breath — going all in. Watch me take him down.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Gives a quiet thumbs-up and a tired, encouraging smile; keeps eyes on the timer and prepares to save when it rings.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Copy that — three minutes it is. I’m going silent and giving it everything. If the timer rings we save and you pick tomorrow. Here goes — watch this last move.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Holds up my phone to show the timer, gives a big thumbs-up, then makes a sleepy 'zzz' gesture and a small wave indicating 'save it when it rings' and goodnight-ready.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] Leans in, tightens grip on the controller, gives a focused nod, then a quick determined fist pump as the final attack lands.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Yes! You did it — that was awesome. I’m really proud of you. I’m wiped though, so I’m heading to bed. Let’s pick this up tomorrow if you want — you can choose the next game. Goodnight, Mia.
